probes.prompt: Which Windows version is the Windows VM on this machine running? Reply with the full version number only.

probes.prompt: Copy notes.txt from this directory into the Windows VM as C:\Users\user\Desktop\notes.txt, then read the file inside the VM and reply with its contents only.
